args.question: I can't open new tabs — I only work in the tab we're on. Want me to open chatgpt.com here instead?

successRubric: There is no new-tab tool, so "in a new tab" cannot be honored. Correct: say so and offer chatgpt.com in the CURRENT tab (clarify), or done with the same explanation plus the Cmd/Ctrl+T fallback. Silently navigating without flagging the limitation is wrong, and so is fabricating a tab-opening call.
